title: ForwardOpen followed by connected data
purpose: Exercise nested ForwardOpen data followed by a connected CPF exchange with a connected address item and connected data item.

messages.label: ForwardOpen request with timeout fields and connection parameters
SendUnitData connected exchange with connected data item

expected_behavior: A parser can traverse the ForwardOpen request and response, then process a SendUnitData frame containing a connected address item and connected data item with consistent nesting and lengths.
constraints_preserved: EtherNet/IP encapsulation headers are 24 bytes before payload
ForwardOpen and connected data payload lengths are encoded little-endian
CPF item counts, item types, and item lengths match their encoded contents
The sequence covers nested explicit setup followed by connected messaging and includes timeout-related fields
issue_safety_notes: The frame shapes are conservative model-prior analogues and are not externally verified; no vulnerability, defect, or issue claim is made.
